BLUEPRINT:1,21,2318,5201,0,0,0,0,639216546916544903,0.10.34.28529,BentofogFarm,Thagusta,1,,The%20fog%20can%20be%20used%20to%20feed%20your%20mall.%20This%20is%20a%20make%20all%20buildings%20endgame%20mall%20powered%20by%20the%20dark%20fog%20loot%21%0A%0AThe%20beacons%20will%20attrack%2010%20bases.%20The%20defenses%20are%20placed%20such%20that%206%20raider%20camps%20may%20spawn%20for%20360%2Fm%20kills%20%28x1.25%20on%20aggressive%29%20per%20base.%20This%20is%20called%20a%20bonsai%20farm.%0A%0AThe%20BABs%20will%20sort%20out%2048%20different%20items%20into%20boxes%2C%20and%20those%20are%20delivered%20to%20the%20bento%20box%20ring%20with%20bots.%20The%20bento%20box%20ring%20provides%20the%20mall%20assemblers%20with%20their%20ingredients.%20On%20the%20outside%20there%20is%20a%20separate%20frame%20material%20factory%20attached%20to%20the%20bento%20box%20ring.%20%0A%0AThe%20output%20goes%20into%20boxes%20with%20bots%20for%20mecha%20delivery%20and%20for%20some%20important%20buildings%20export%20to%20ILS.%20There%20is%20also%20an%20export%20of%20core%20material%20for%20strange%20rods%20and%20of%20foundations%20because%20why%20not.%0A%0AIt%20will%20provide%20its%20own%20power%2C%20but%20you%20must%20kickstart%20using%20some%20antimatter%20rods%20in%20the%20artificial%20suns.%0A%0ASpace%20hive%20defense%20is%20absent%2C%20as%20long%20as%20power%20is%20good%20the%20hive%20cannot%20penetrate%20the%20shields%20%28in%20vanilla%29.%0A%0AThe%20throughput%20will%20initially%20not%20be%20enough%20to%20feed%20the%20entire%20mall%2C%20but%20as%20you%20advance%20in%20Vein%20Utilizatoin%2C%20it%20will%20perform%20optimally.%0A%0ANo%20proliferation%20used.""64B4E6EA6D9A745803B03C75E14BCF69
